name: Crown ring 3R: J1 an open thin-section ring on the crown
verdict: screened, not worth a GPU sweep as a ring: the open ring at J1 loses to an O20 hub on the same axes by 20-26 gap at every size and seat (best ring passing the parking rule 82.37 vs its O20 control 56.04, k235); convergence gate NOT met (ring g2 70.05 / g3 70.05 / top-5 1.16 with the parking rule, 1.84 / 1.84 / 1.47 without)
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, K3 march, K2 dense, K6, audit clean; 236 configs (144 coarse + 3 CMA gens of 28 on the farm + 8 local). Gate (score points) ring with parking rule: gain 2nd half 70.05, last third 70.05, top-5 1.16 (no coarse ring passes parking: hub 2 at 161); without: 1.84 / 1.84 / 1.47 - NOT converged. Spec fixes: link-1 lug root collides with the land in every pose (K6 partner zone is 12 mm), so link 1 rides on the rotor top (over ring1 0.6 mm) or a 7 mm lug; two-pass ring level. In-model O20-hub control k235 = 56.04 (score 79.62; J1 bvec(29.9, 89.0), a12 82.6, a23 66.8, J3 wdir(92.2, 6.8), q 0.998; reach 0.90 follow 1.00 ib14 0.345 ib10 0.203 contact 0.005; hub 2 139.5 mm, parking ok): hand to the verifier / spherical-family CMA.
limiter: ring land level (posed skin, 220 bench poses): a flat annulus normal to a GH ray fits the crown only to ~20-25 mm radius; KA020-KA030 (outer 36.6-49.3 mm) sit 74-133 mm from GH vs 52-58 for an O20 hub, set by the trapezius (medial, az -70..-88) or the clavicle/anterior deltoid (lateral tilt); ring 1-12 % in band; hub 2 113-140 mm (~3 % in band); smallest ring contacts the skin across the body (plane 135-150, elev 105-135, -6.7 mm)
